description: Official Wizards of the Coast Commander bracket sources. The source text is downloaded locally and is not redistributed by this repository. Each SHA-256 value fingerprints the .txt rendition retrieved on 2026-09-12 and is used only as a drift detector; the per-source anchor is the assertion enforced by the fetch script. These are live pages, so drift is expected over time and a drift warning is not a failure.

sources.anchor: There is also a list of what is expected at that level in a few barometers: two-card infinite combos, extra turns, mass land denial.
sources.paraphrase: The live format page; names the three bracket barometers and the Game Changers list.

sources.anchor: keep lands tapped, or change what mana is produced by four or more lands per player
sources.paraphrase: Original bracket announcement; defines the mass land denial class and names its five examples.

sources.anchor: remove the tutor restrictions from Commander Brackets entirely
sources.paraphrase: Re-anchors each bracket on a turns-before-win expectation, decouples Bracket 2 from precons, and removes the tutor restrictions entirely.
Latest update; adds Farewell and Biorhythm to Game Changers and restates that brackets guide a pregame conversation rather than arbitrate one.
